nodes.description: Public string token name set in the constructor to 'Hong Kong £'.
Public string token symbol set in the constructor to 'HK£'.
Public uint8 number of decimals, hardcoded to 0 in the constructor.
Public uint256 total token supply, initialized to 888888888888 and assigned to the deployer.
Private mapping(address => uint) holding token balances of every account.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding ERC20 allowances.
Constructor that initializes name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and credits balances[msg.sender].
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked subtraction.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' by updating balances and allowed[from][msg.sender] without an explicit allowance check.
Library function computing c = a + b and requiring c >= a.
Library function requiring b <= a then computing c = a - b.
Library function computing c = a * b and requiring a == 0 || c / a == b.
Library function requiring b > 0 then computing c = a / b.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender across privileged state updates.
Raw unchecked arithmetic _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply, prone to underflow on Solidity 0.5.
Addition a + b inside safeAdd, guarded only by require(c >= a).
Subtraction a - b inside safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication a * b inside safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
State writes balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) and balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transfer.
State writes on balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and balances[to] inside transferFrom, performed without verifying sufficient allowance.
Address parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Address parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Address parameter spender of allowance.
Address parameter spender of approve.
uint parameter tokens of approve.
Address parameter 'to' of transfer.
uint parameter tokens of transfer.
Address parameter 'from' of transferFrom.
Address parameter 'to' of transferFrom.
uint parameter tokens of transferFrom.
uint parameter a of safeAdd.
uint parameter b of safeAdd.
uint parameter a of safeSub.
uint parameter b of safeSub.
uint parameter a of safeMul.
uint parameter b of safeMul.
uint parameter a of safeDiv.
uint parameter b of safeDiv.
Return variable 'balance' of balanceOf holding balances[tokenOwner].
Return variable 'remaining' of allowance holding allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Return variable 'success' of approve.
Return variable 'success' of transfer.
Return variable 'success' of transferFrom.
Return variable c of safeAdd holding a + b.
Return variable c of safeSub holding a - b.
Return variable c of safeMul holding a * b.
Return variable c of safeDiv holding a / b.

edges.reason: Caller address msg.sender is written into the balances mapping during construction, giving the deployer the whole supply.
approve stores tokens under allowed[msg.sender][spender], using the caller-controlled address as the allowance owner.
transfer reads and rewrites balances[msg.sender], so the caller address directly drives the state update.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key when decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender].
_totalSupply flows into the unchecked subtraction performed by totalSupply.
balances[address(0)] is subtracted from _totalSupply inside totalSupply.
The balances mapping is read and written by the transfer balance updates.
The balances mapping is read and written by the transferFrom balance updates.
The allowed mapping is decremented in transferFrom without an explicit allowance precondition.
allowance returns the value stored in allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
balanceOf returns the value stored in balances[tokenOwner].
transfer credits the recipient address parameter 'to' in the balances mapping.
transfer amount parameter 'tokens' drives the debit and credit balance updates.
transferFrom debits balances[from] using the address parameter 'from'.
transferFrom credits balances[to] using the address parameter 'to'.
transferFrom amount parameter 'tokens' drives all three state updates.
Parameter a is an operand of the addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of the addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter a is the minuend of the subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend and the require bound inside safeSub.
Parameter a is an operand of the multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter b is an operand of the multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter a is the dividend of the division inside safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor checked and used inside safeDiv.
tokenOwner parameter selects the mapping entry returned by balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter selects the outer mapping key read by allowance.
spender parameter selects the inner mapping key read by allowance.
spender parameter is the inner key written by approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
The constructor assigns the fixed initial value to _totalSupply.
The constructor executes the initial balances[msg.sender] assignment.
approve unconditionally overwrites the allowed mapping entry.
transfer calls safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balances[from] debit.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the balances[to] credit.
totalSupply evaluates the unchecked subtraction node, which is vulnerable to underflow.
safeAdd guards the addition node with a post-condition require on the result.
safeSub guards the subtraction node with require(b <= a).
safeMul guards the multiplication node with a division-based overflow check.
safeDiv guards the division node with require(b > 0).
transfer performs the guarded arithmetic balance updates for sender and recipient.
transferFrom performs guarded arithmetic updates on balances and allowed without an allowance check.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenOwner parameter only selects the balances entry read by balanceOf and carries no independent semantics.
The tokenOwner parameter is only the outer lookup key of allowance.
The spender parameter is only the inner lookup key of allowance.
The spender parameter is only the allowance key written by approve.
The tokens parameter is only the allowance value written by approve.
The 'to' parameter is only the recipient key credited by transfer.
The tokens parameter is only the amount driving the transfer balance updates.
The 'from' parameter is only the debit key used by transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is only the credit key used by transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is only the amount driving the transferFrom state updates.
Parameter a exists solely as an operand of the safeAdd addition node.
Parameter b exists solely as an operand of the safeAdd addition node.
Parameter a exists solely as an operand of the safeSub subtraction node.
Parameter b exists solely as an operand and bound of the safeSub subtraction node.
Parameter a exists solely as an operand of the safeMul multiplication node.
Parameter b exists solely as an operand of the safeMul multiplication node.
Parameter a exists solely as an operand of the safeDiv division node.
Parameter b exists solely as an operand and guard of the safeDiv division node.
The return variable balance of balanceOf is a direct alias of the returned mapping value.
The return variable remaining of allowance is a direct alias of the returned mapping value.
The return variable success of approve is a constant true flag with no independent semantics.
The return variable success of transfer is a constant true flag with no independent semantics.
The return variable success of transferFrom is a constant true flag with no independent semantics.
Local c of safeAdd is just the result of the addition node.
Local c of safeSub is just the result of the subtraction node.
Local c of safeMul is just the result of the multiplication node.
Local c of safeDiv is just the result of the division node.
